headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. The Los Angeles Dodgers also secured a win, defeating the New York Yankees 8-2. Trent Grisham led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Max Meyer, a right-hander for the Miami Marlins, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain. Other players on the injured list include Phil Maton of the Chicago Cubs, Miguel Andujar of the San Diego Padres, Adley Rutschman of the Baltimore Orioles, Will Vest of the Detroit Tigers, PJ Poulin of the Washington Nationals, Richard Lovelady of the Washington Nationals, and Ryan Helsley of the Baltimore Orioles.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for right-handed pitchers Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek. The Chicago Cubs have also made a trade, acquiring right-hander Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-hander Aiden Moffett. Additionally, the Baltimore Orioles have acquired outfielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Blue Jays 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a shutout victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Sean Burke pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 5 and walking 1.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers secured an 8-2 victory over the New York Yankees, led by a strong performance from their pitching staff. Trent Grisham led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers dropped a 1-2 decision to the New York Yankees, failing to secure a win. Tommy Edman led the Dodgers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 6-1 victory. Willson Contreras led the Rays' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Max Meyer Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Miami Marlins right-hander Max Meyer has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a neck strain, effective retroactive to July 19, 2026.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitchers Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
